relationships.subject: lipopolysaccharide
relationships.evidence_quote: the plasma level of various cytokines and chemokines, including IL-1β and IL-6, were significantly increased only in LPS-treated mice

relationships.subject: lipopolysaccharide
relationships.evidence_quote: Lipidomic analysis showed 5 h after LPS or zymosan injection in both models an increase of ether-phosphatidylcholines (PC O) and their corresponding lyso species

key_findings: LPS but not zymosan paw inflammation alters contralateral paw lipids and raises plasma cytokines, indicating systemic acute phase response
Both models increase PC O and lyso-PC O at the inflamed site
